base_member_text: [L10,L42,L47,L144-L152] (MED/staleness-contract) The manual hard-codes version 0.1.0, a 2008 copyright, and a named author's email as the version/help/reporting contract without documenting how these values are maintained.
audit_member_text: [L10,L42] (LOW/documentation-versioning) The manual hard-codes version 0.1.0 instead of obtaining the version from the build, so its advertised version can diverge from the documented executable.

base_member_text: [L46] (MED/build-typo) The title-page TeX command is written as \\vfilll, which is not the standard plain-TeX \\vfill command and may cause manual generation to fail.
[L68-L70] (LOW/documentation-typo) The sentence describing the command contains a doubled terminal period and is grammatically incomplete ('which a two-dimensional model').

audit_member_text: [L33-L36,L58-L61] (LOW/notice-ambiguity) The translation permission refers to approval by the Foundation without identifying that organization anywhere in this manual.
[L99,L102,L158] (LOW/template-residue) The GNU program attribution and index entries for greetings and tail recursion appear to be unrelated template residue in the XBeach manual.

[L102-L104,L132-L136] (MED/usage-contract) The invocation instructions name params.txt but omit where it is resolved and how to supply its required contents, leaving the documented command insufficient to reproduce a run.

[L145-L146] (LOW/cli-contract) Bug-report instructions require xbeach --version although the invocation section documents no options or version-query behavior, leaving this command's support unestablished by the manual.
